snippet.title: Drywall Eating Simulator - OUT NOW
snippet.description:
Drywall Eating Simulator is a physics-based 3D adventure game where you are pushed to the limits of human (or nonhuman) tolerance by the people you encounter in our world, and the only pressure release that you have is in the name of the game (eating drywall)

Wishlist on Steam! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3749110/Drywall_Eating_Simulator/

Checkout our socials and more at https://www.peripheralplaybox.com/
